title: Arena Allocator
description: Write a Zig program that implements a simple arena allocator that allocates memory and frees it all at once.
verificationTest: output.includes('Hello, Arena!') && output.includes('0') && output.includes('10') && output.includes('20') && output.includes('30') && output.includes('40')
hints: `std.heap.ArenaAllocator` allocates from page_allocator and frees all memory at once with `deinit()`
`defer` ensures cleanup runs when the scope exits, even on errors
Use `try` with allocator methods since they may return OutOfMemory errors
`.dupe(u8, "...")` creates a heap-allocated copy of a string
